title: 🎫 Enforce Emoji Prefix on Ticket Titles
description: Every ticket MUST have an emoji. Extend the existing CLI (repo/cli/main.go) to enforce this on CreateTicket and UpdateTicketTitle. Reject titles that do not start with an emoji. Update Slugify/ticket identity so the emoji is preserved as the first artifact of the ticket slug. Extend main_test.go with new test cases covering emoji-prefixed titles (valid) and emoji-less titles (invalid). Do not care about breaking legacy API. Do not create new files.
summary: Enforced emoji prefix on every ticket title. Added `validateTicketTitle` helper in `repo/cli/main.go` that: (1) rejects empty titles, (2) requires a leading emoji via existing `extractEntityEmoji`, (3) requires non-empty text after the emoji, (4) applies the existing titleized/not-slug check against the body after the emoji (so `🎫 SOME-SLUG-TITLE` is rejected). Wired it into both `CreateTicket` and `UpdateTicketTitle` to replace the previous inline title checks. Extended `TestTicketTitleValidation` in `repo/cli/main_test.go` with 12 cases covering emoji-prefixed valid titles and various emoji-less / emoji-only / emoji+slug invalid titles. Updated all other ticket-creating tests (`TestTicketOpenContinueKeyword`, `TestCliE2E_TicketLifecycle_Syntaxes_NoManagement`, `TestCliE2E_TicketLifecycle_Modes`, `TestTicketLifecycle_NoManagement`, `TestTrackHookInOpenTicketUsesStableSessionIDs`, `TestToolTicketLifecycle`, `TestMcpTicketCloseAutoResolve`, `TestMcpTicketCloseWithFullYearPath`) to use emoji-prefixed titles. Also fixed `parseTicketOpenResult` to normalize Windows backslash paths via `filepath.ToSlash` so the E2E lifecycle test actually passes on Windows. All ticket-related tests pass; remaining full-suite failures (`TestGetClientHookMappings`, `TestExtractTestStartingFromInputResolvesTestIDs`, `TestExtractTestEndedFromInputResolvesFiles`, `TestExtractSearchDefinitionReadsFromInput`, `TestRunHookSearchStartingIncludesDefinitions`) are pre-existing and unrelated to ticket title validation.
